WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), first_cut AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_length
  FROM rating_averages
  WHERE avg_length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film)
), second_cut AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_length
  FROM first_cut
  WHERE avg_length > (SELECT AVG(avg_length) FROM first_cut)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_remaining_average_length,
       AVG(avg_length - (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film)) AS avg_above_overall_mean,
       AVG(avg_length - (SELECT AVG(avg_length) FROM first_cut)) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean
FROM second_cut;
